Luxury Castle Hotel Ireland
Escape to Kilronan Castle Estate & Spa, a Luxury Castle Hotel in Ireland, located in the scenic County Roscommon, in the West of Ireland. Surrounded by 50 acres of peaceful woodland and next to Lough Meelagh, our 18th-century castle offers the perfect retreat to relax, unwind, and experience true luxury.
A Unique Castle Experience
From the moment you enter through the old castle gates, you step into a world of charm and calm. Whether you’re here for a short break or a special occasion, Kilronan Castle offers something unforgettable. As a premier Luxury Castle Hotel in Ireland, Kilronan Castle provides unmatched hospitality, stunning views, and world-class dining options.
Sleep in Style – Stay in elegant rooms with four-poster beds, antique furniture, and modern touches. Every detail is designed for comfort.
Enjoy Fine Dining – Taste award-winning food created by Executive Head Chef Daniel Willimont. Each dish is made with fresh, local ingredients and lots of care.
Relax at the Spa – Visit our luxury spa and choose from a wide range of soothing treatments. It’s the perfect place to rest and recharge.
More Than Just a Stay
Kilronan Castle is more than just a hotel. It’s a place where you can feel at home, explore the outdoors, and make lasting memories.
Whether it’s a romantic escape, a wellness weekend, or a family celebration, your time here will be special.
Book your stay today and enjoy one of Ireland’s most beautiful castle hotel experiences.

Frequently asked questions
Q: How Far is Kilronan Castle from Dublin Airport
A:  Kilronan Castle is approximately 2 hours from Dublin Airport, only 50 minutes from Knock and approximately 3.5 hours to Shannon
Q: What time is breakfast served?
A: Breakfast is served in the Douglas Hyde Restaurant from 7.30am until 10.30am
Q:  What is the closest towns to the hotel for shopping?
A: Carrick on Shannon is only 20 minutes, and Sligo is 30 minutes drive from the castle
Q.: Do you have Wifi?
A: In public Areas, yes
Q: Where is the nearest train station to you?
A: Boyle and Carrick on Shannon are both 20 minutes away

About Kilronan Castle Estate & Spa – A Historic Castle Hotel in Ireland
Kilronan Castle Estate & Spa is a historic castle hotel in Ireland full of charm, history, and natural beauty. Nestled in County Roscommon, the castle sits beside Lough Meelagh and is surrounded by 50 acres of quiet woodland.
For over 300 years, the noble Tenison family lived here. However, when they left, the estate sadly fell into decline. In 2007, Alan Hanly, through his Hanly Group of companies, brought the castle back to life. It was restored carefully, keeping its historical feel while adding modern comfort and luxury.
Today, Kilronan Castle welcomes guests into a world of timeless elegance. As soon as you step through the gates, you’ll feel the peaceful atmosphere and warm Irish hospitality. Some of the authentic castle rooms feature four-poster beds and antique furniture. In addition, the fine dining and award-winning spa offer unforgettable experiences.
Whether you re planning a romantic escape or a family gathering, Kilronan Castle offers more than just a place to stay. It creates moments you’ll remember forever. Our team works hard to make every visit special.

Castle History | Hotel County Roscommon | Kilronan Castle Estate & Spa Bed & Breakfast Special Offers Gift Vouchers
The Rich Castle History of Kilronan Castle
The name Kilronan comes from the Gaelic Cill Ronain , which means “Ronan’s Abbey.” According to tradition, Saint Ronan and his daughter, Saint Lasair, built a church beside Lough Meelagh in the 6th century. However, it was the arrival of the Tenison family that truly put this area on the map.
The Tenison Family’s Arrival
In the late 13th century, the Tenison family came from Oxfordshire to Ireland. They settled in the north of Ireland in the mid-1600s. Over time, the Tenisons became soldiers in the Irish Brigade, fighting in France, Spain, and Portugal. Later, many served in the Irish Guards during the Boer Wars. Despite their military service, they often found themselves in need of money. As a result, they frequently married wealthy heiresses to restore their fortunes.
Building the Castle
In 1803, Thomas Tenison, then an MP for Boyle, married Lady Frances Anne King, the daughter of the 1st Earl of Kingston. Following their marriage, the Tenison family name changed to King-Tenison. Soon after, they decided to build a grand home. They demolished their old house and constructed a new residence fit for their elevated status. This new castle was called Castle Tenison. Located at the end of a tree-lined avenue, the castle was built next to the picturesque Lough Meelagh. It was a stunning three-storey building with symmetrical blocks, slender turrets, and intricate fan-vaulted plasterwork.
Expansion and Glory
Then, in 1876, Lieutenant-Colonel Edward King-Tenison, the 12th Earl of Kingston, and his wife, Lady Louisa, expanded the castle. They added two more storeys and built a magnificent baronial tower. At this point, the estate became well-known throughout Ireland. The quality of shooting on the grounds attracted people from all over to visit and enjoy the beauty of the estate.
Decline and Abandonment
However, as political changes took place in Ireland, the family’s visits to the castle grew less frequent. Eventually, in the 1930s, the castle was sold. In 1939, the contents of the castle were auctioned off. Then, in the 1950s, the roof was removed in an attempt to reduce high taxes. By this time, only the walls of the castle remained.
Restoration and Renewal
In 2004, the Hanly Group, led by Alan Hanly, began restoring Kilronan Castle. They worked hard to bring back the original features of the castle, blending its rich history with modern luxury. Today, Kilronan Castle Estate & Spa offers a unique combination of old-world charm and new-world elegance, making it a must-visit destination for all.

Our Hotels | Luxury Castle Hotel | Kilronan Castle Estate Bed & Breakfast Special Offers Gift Vouchers
Welcome to the Hanly Castle Hotel Group , one of Ireland’s most prestigious luxury castle hotel group. Nestled among the lush woodlands of County Roscommon, Kilronan Castle Estate & Spa offers an unparalleled blend of historical charm, five-star luxury, and heartfelt Irish hospitality. Whether you’re searching for the perfect romantic escape, a spectacular wedding venue, or a serene spa retreat, our castle estate provides a fairytale setting that leaves lasting impressions.
The Hanly Castle Hotel Group is an established Irish-owned collection of luxury castle accommodations, each property offering its own unique story and grandeur. We are proud to uphold the highest standards of service and quality across our magical destinations.
Our sister property, the breathtaking Lough Rynn Castle Estate & Gardens , is located just 35 minutes away near Mohill in County Leitrim . This 18th-century castle is steeped in history and surrounded by beautifully manicured gardens and the tranquil Lough Rynn Lake. It’s a haven for those seeking luxury, peace, and the essence of old-world charm in the heart of the West of Ireland.
We’re also delighted to introduce the latest addition to our growing collection— Kinnitty Castle in County Offaly. Set against the stunning backdrop of the Slieve Bloom Mountains, Kinnitty Castle is a Gothic-style castle hotel dating back to the 13th century. With its enchanting turrets, opulent interiors, and rich heritage, it offers a one-of-a-kind experience in medieval-style luxury. It’s the perfect complement to our portfolio, giving guests yet another opportunity to stay in a genuine Irish castle steeped in character and culture.
Each property in the Hanly Castle Hotel Group is committed to offering exceptional experiences across Ireland’s most scenic and historic locations. Whether you re staying at Kilronan Castle Estate & Spa , exploring the elegance of Lough Rynn Castle Estate & Gardens , or discovering the mystical charm of Kinnitty Castle , you’re guaranteed a truly memorable escape.
To begin planning your luxury Irish castle getaway, explore our exclusive offers , browse our wedding venue , or discover more about our growing collection of castle hotels below.
Lough Rynn Castle
Covering three hundred acres of the greenest grass, the oldest trees and the most scenic shore line that the west of Ireland has to offer, Lough Rynn Castle Estate & Gardens contains the ancestral home of the legendary Lord Leitrim and his family, the Clements. This magnificent Victorian Manor, the finest of the big homes made famous in Ireland during that era, stood majestically against the backdrop of Lough Rynn for more than 200 years, until it was lovingly brought back to life by a passionate and dedicated father and son team.
Visit Site
Kinnitty Castle
Kinnitty Castle dates back to around 350 AD, originally built by the O’Carrolls and later home to a 6th-century abbey. It was destroyed and rebuilt several times through Norman, Danish, and Cromwellian invasions. The current structure was built in 1630, transformed into a Gothic mansion in 1811, and rebuilt after being burned in 1922. In 1994, it became the luxurious 37-bedroom hotel enjoyed today.
Visit Site
Kilronan Castle
Ireland is a country famous for its incredible castles and Kilronan Castle Estate & Spa is one of its finest examples of the vision, splendour and elegance of the era when these homes graced our lush green landscape. This magnificent Gothic manor is unique in that its history can be traced right back through the royal family who resided there. For more than 300 years, this 40-acre estate remained in the Tenison family, before falling into disrepair in their absence.
